+def _dependency_solver(name_order, preference):
+    def solve(data):
+        packages = data["packages"]
+        features = set(data.get("features", []))
+        blocked = data.get("blocked", {})
+        pins = data.get("pins", {})
+        names = sorted(packages, reverse=(name_order == "descending"))
+        best_vector = None
+        best = None
+
+        def acyclic(edges):
+            visiting, done = set(), set()
+
+            def visit(name):
+                if name in visiting:
+                    return False
+                if name in done:
+                    return True
+                visiting.add(name)
+                if any(not visit(child) for child in edges.get(name, [])):
+                    return False
+                visiting.remove(name)
+                done.add(name)
+                return True
+
+            return all(visit(name) for name in edges)
+
+        def search(chosen, bounds, edges):
+            nonlocal best, best_vector
+            remaining = [name for name in bounds if name not in chosen]
+            if not remaining:
+                if not acyclic(edges):
+                    return
+                vector = tuple(chosen.get(name, -1) for name in names)
+                if (best_vector is None or
+                        (vector < best_vector if preference == "minimum" else vector > best_vector)):
+                    best_vector = vector
+                    best = dict(chosen)
+                return
+
+            name = min(remaining)
+            low, high = bounds[name]
+            rows = [row for row in packages[name]
+                    if low <= row["version"] <= high
+                    and row["version"] not in blocked.get(name, [])
+                    and (name not in pins or row["version"] == pins[name])]
+            rows.sort(key=lambda row: row["version"], reverse=(preference == "maximum"))
+            for row in rows:
+                version = row["version"]
+                next_chosen = dict(chosen)
+                next_bounds = dict(bounds)
+                next_edges = dict(edges)
+                next_chosen[name] = version
+                active = [dep for dep in row.get("deps", [])
+                          if not dep.get("feature") or dep["feature"] in features]
+                next_edges[name] = [dep["name"] for dep in active]
+                valid = True
+                for dep in active:
+                    child = dep["name"]
+                    dep_low, dep_high = dep["min"], dep["max"]
+                    old_low, old_high = next_bounds.get(child, (1, 9))
+                    new_low, new_high = max(old_low, dep_low), min(old_high, dep_high)
+                    if new_low > new_high:
+                        valid = False
+                        break
+                    next_bounds[child] = (new_low, new_high)
+                    if child in next_chosen and not new_low <= next_chosen[child] <= new_high:
+                        valid = False
+                        break
+                if valid:
+                    search(next_chosen, next_bounds, next_edges)
+
+        roots = {name: (bounds[0], bounds[1]) for name, bounds in data["roots"].items()}
+        search({}, roots, {})
+        if best is None:
+            return {"error": "unsatisfiable"}
+        return {"versions": best}
+
+    return solve
+

 def _build_component_07():
+    from itertools import combinations
+
+    def solve(data):
+        jobs = data["jobs"]
+        k = data["k"]
+        blocked = set(data.get("blocked", []))
+        mandatory = set(data.get("mandatory", []))
+        quotas = data.get("quotas", {})
+        options = [job for job in jobs if job["id"] not in blocked]
+        best_value = None
+        best_ids = None
+
+        for subset in combinations(options, k):
+            ids = [job["id"] for job in subset]
+            id_set = set(ids)
+            if not mandatory.issubset(id_set):
+                continue
+            ordered = sorted(subset, key=lambda job: (job["start"], job["end"], job["id"]))
+            if any(ordered[i]["start"] < ordered[i - 1]["end"]
+                   for i in range(1, len(ordered))):
+                continue
+            counts = {}
+            for job in subset:
+                group = job["group"]
+                counts[group] = counts.get(group, 0) + 1
+            if any(not low <= counts.get(group, 0) <= high
+                   for group, (low, high) in quotas.items()):
+                continue
+            value = sum(job["value"] for job in subset)
+            sorted_ids = sorted(ids)
+            if (best_value is None or value > best_value or
+                    (value == best_value and sorted_ids < best_ids)):
+                best_value, best_ids = value, sorted_ids
+
+        if best_value is None:
+            return {"error": "impossible"}
+        return {"selected": best_ids, "value": best_value}
+
+    return solve
+
